text:
Platinum Price in 2023
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2023, the LBMA platinum price fell 0.4% between 2023-01-31 ($1,004) and 2023-12-28 ($1,000). The highest sampled price was $1,074 in April and the lowest was $897 in June. The mean of these observations was $970. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
